The PR changes shell snapshot helper subprocesses to use ignored stdio instead of an unused stdout pipe and adds a production-path spawn regression test.

PR surface: Source -6, Tests +71. Total +65 across 2 files.

target.title: fix(agents): avoid shell snapshot stdout pipe failures
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where shell snapshot helper commands could crash OpenClaw if their unused stdout pipe emitted a stream error.

## Why This Change Was Made

Both `runShell` callers only consume the child exit status, while snapshot capture output is already redirected to a private temporary file. The helper now spawns with ignored stdio instead of creating and draining an unused stdout pipe, removing the error source entirely.

The original report and fix direction remain credited to @lsr911. The maintainer repair replaces the standalone proof script with durable coverage of the production shell-snapshot path.

## User Impact

Shell snapshot capture and validation no longer expose an unused stdout stream that can emit an unhandled error. Existing fallback, timeout, and process-tree cleanup behavior is unchanged.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/shell-snapshot.spawn.test.ts src/agents/shell-snapshot.test.ts` - 14/14 passed.
- Regression red check: restoring `stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "ignore"]` makes `shell-snapshot.spawn.test.ts` fail on the production spawn contract.
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/agents/shell-snapshot.ts src/agents/shell-snapshot.spawn.test.ts` - passed.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/agents/shell-snapshot.ts src/agents/shell-snapshot.spawn.test.ts` - passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` - passed.
- `codex review --base origin/main` - no findings; confirmed ignored stdio is the correct fix because neither caller consumes stdout.

Focused local proof only. Testbox was intentionally not used because Blacksmith is unavailable.
